name: Reactive Resume v6
description: Reactive Resume v6 resume builder. This is a new app, separate from Reactive Resume v5. v6 stores uploads on a local volume, renders PDFs in the app, and bundles PostgreSQL 18. It does not include MinIO, Redis, or Browserless. Do not attach it to a v5 database volume. A v5 database migration is one-way, and PostgreSQL 18 cannot open the v5 data directory.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Auth secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  big-bear-reactive-resume-v6:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume-v6
    image: amruthpillai/reactive-resume:v6.0.6@sha256:9ba846665ec3b703c904f61ed75cc0e2c0fe71efd2fd51f45600c6ce23744e78
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    depends_on:
      big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      APP_URL: "http://localhost:3028"
      AUTH_SECRET: ${SECRET_AUTH_SECRET}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-db:5432/postgres"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/app/data
    networks:
      - big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-network
  big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-db:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-db
    image: postgres:18@sha256:74935e72241653ca55e0414067e6d8763aceb8a810eb51b452253ec3dcfc4336
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: postgres
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "postgres"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pg:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d postgres"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    networks:
      - big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-network
networks:
  big-bear-reactive-resume-v6-network:
    driver: bridge
